title.zh: 与[From.GetName]通过维持现状结束战争

texts.zh: 好吧。没有赢家，也没有胜利者。只有失去的生命，和残骸……
texts.en: Very well. No winner, no victor. Only lost lives, lost scrap...

texts.zh: 没有明确获胜方的战争是可耻的悲剧，但有时确实无法避免。我们改日战场上再见吧。
texts.en: A war without a clear winner is a tragic and shameful sight, but sometimes unavoidable. Let us fight again another day.

texts.zh: 我们同意以当前边界为标准终止这次冲突。
texts.en: We will agree to end this conflict as the borders currently stand.

texts.zh: 帝国恢复正常，和平的历史继续进展，这对我们各自都有好处。
texts.en: A return to the normal state of things and resumption of peacetime activities would be best for all parties.

texts.zh: 鉴于目前的情况，我们应该立刻结束这次冲突。与其深陷这次冲突的泥潭不能自拔，[This.GetName]倒不如找些有意义的事来做。
texts.en: The circumstances dictate that we put an end to this war. The [This.GetName] has better things to do than pursue this conflict indefinitely.

texts.zh: 我们希望，停止敌对可以使[Root.GetName]和[This.GetName]开启全新的外交对话。
texts.en: We hope ceasing hostilities will open up for new diplomatic dialogue between the [Root.GetName] and the [This.GetName].

texts.zh: 尽管我们不愿意看到你们逃脱了惩罚，但我们同样也希望你们这些卑鄙的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult]至少明白不要干涉我们的事务。
texts.en: As much as we hate to see you escape unpunished, we hope you miserable [Root.GetSpeciesNamePluralInsult] have at least learned to stay out of our business.

texts.zh: [This.GetName]需要时间恢复。我们同意在此结束战争。
texts.en: The [This.GetName] needs time to recuperate. We have agreed to end our conflict here.

texts.zh: 由于双方都无心进一步索取，我们希望创伤的治愈过程能够缩短。请不要因既成事实而对[This.GetSpeciesName]心存憎恨。
texts.en: With no further demands on either side, we hope that the healing process can be shortened. Do not resent the [This.GetSpeciesName] for what has been done.

texts.zh: 虽然我们没有贯彻正义，但我们只能终止战争。不过，神之惩罚终将降临到你们头上。
texts.en: We are forced to put an end to this without delivering proper justice, but you cannot escape the divine punishment that will befall you.

texts.zh: 这只是暂时的停战。我们不会放弃消灭[Root.GetSpeciesName]的使命。
texts.en: Consider this a ceasefire. We have not given up on our mission to eradicate the [Root.GetSpeciesName].

texts.zh: 停战约定应该是[Root.GetAdj]打破枷锁、争取交流对话的第一步。
texts.en: Negotiating a truce can be seen as the first step towards a diplomatic conversation about the liberties of the [Root.GetAdj] people.

texts.zh: 懒惰的[Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，就算拿来当苦力也没什么用。看来议和是最好的选项了。
texts.en: Lazy [Root.GetSpeciesNamePlural] wouldn't be any good to us even as slaves. Peace might be the best option after all.

texts.zh: 乏味的战争，乏味的结局。我们还是各自去拥抱生命中更加美好的东西吧。
texts.en: A thoroughly dull ending to a thoroughly dull war. Let us return to the better things in life.

texts.zh: 考虑到目前状况，双方都不再进一步退让，就此结束冲突是最为合理的行为了。
texts.en: Ending the war now with no further concessions on either side is the most rational course of action, judging by its current state.

texts.zh: 如果双方再互相攻击，就会造成无法调节的失衡。若签订和平条约，则可保持精神上的长久均衡。
texts.en: If you would try to further take from us, or we from you, an imbalance would be created that cannot be corrected. A peace deal ensures continued spiritual equilibrium.

texts.zh: [This.GetAdj]人民同意结束这场战争，立即生效。
texts.en: The [This.GetAdj] people has agreed to bring an end to this war, effective immediately.

texts.zh: 现在，我们完全可以和平相处。但如果你们闯入了圣地，你们的未来将再无和平可言。
texts.en: For now, we will have peace, but there will be no peace in your future if you violate the holy sites.

texts.zh: 我们不会再继续向你要求什么了，但我们恳求你，请考虑一下我们的智慧，再想想如果忽略了我们的智慧会有何等的后果。
texts.en: We cannot demand anything further of you, but we implore you, consider our wisdom and what may happen if you ignore it.

texts.zh: 你们活该被碾碎，但这并不值得我们浪费宝贵的时间。看来议和是无法避免的了。
texts.en: You deserve to be utterly crushed, but you do not deserve our valuable time. Peace seems unavoidable after all.

texts.zh: 我们已深陷战争泥潭。就让我们当做什么都没发生过吧，同样也希望这样的事情以后也永远不会发生。
texts.en: We let ourselves get too involved in this. Let us pretend as if it never happened, and hope it does not happen again.

texts.zh: 现在，我们完全可以和平相处。但如果你们闯入了圣地，你们的未来将再无和平可言。
texts.en: For now, we will have peace, but there will be no peace in your future if you violate the holy sites.

texts.zh: 我们不会再继续向你要求什么了，但我们恳求你，请考虑一下我们的智慧，再想想如果忽略了我们的智慧会有何等的后果。
texts.en: We cannot demand anything further of you, but we implore you, consider our wisdom and what may happen if you ignore it.

texts.zh: 你们活该被碾碎，但这并不值得我们浪费宝贵的时间。看来议和是无法避免的了。
texts.en: You deserve to be utterly crushed, but you do not deserve our valuable time. Peace seems unavoidable after all.

texts.zh: 我们已深陷战争泥潭。就让我们当做什么都没发生过吧，同样也希望这样的事情以后也永远不会发生。
texts.en: We let ourselves get too involved in this. Let us pretend as if it never happened, and hope it does not happen again.

texts.zh: 惩罚进程中断。自卫协议终止。
texts.en: Punishment process interrupted. Self-defense protocols ended.

texts.zh: 惩罚进程中断。自卫协议终止。
texts.en: Punishment process interrupted. Self-defense protocols ended.
<<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>> <<ERROR>>

texts.zh: 不真实。
texts.en: Untrue.

texts.zh: 是的。我们要回归常态。变化……变化并非好事。我们可不想打破平衡
texts.en: Yes. We shall return to the normal. Change... Change is not good. We wouldn't want to disturb the Balance.

texts.zh: 令人印象深刻。若是在我们的时代，你们一定会有出色的表现。也许你们能守住沙拉什，而不像其他人那样失败。我们改日再战！
texts.en: Impressive. You would have done well back in our time. Perhaps you could have defended Shallash where others failed. We must do this again sometime!

texts.zh: 我们没有时间可以和你们过家家，星系需要我们的引导。不要再来碍我们的事了。
texts.en: We have no more time to waste on you, the galaxy calls for our guidance. Don't get in our way again.

texts.zh: 没时间再跟你们浪费了，星系需要我们的指引。别再挡我们的道。
texts.en: Yes, we have fed enough here. There are more well stocked larders out in the galaxy. We won't - can't starve.

texts.zh: 战争结束了。没有胜败。
texts.en: This war is over. There can be no victor this time.

label.en: We will accept this for now.
